items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Flip Phillips, Charlie Parker, Sonny Stitt and Dexter Gordon, all those guys

ctx.x: Yeah, a lot of things happened after that. All right, you and Miguelito Valdes were a guest on his show one time. There's a photograph of that, how did that come about?

Well, he was - he fell in love with Miguelito's showmanship. He went to La Conga many, many times and in account that I was the one to accompany Miguelito and already I was mentioned to be made the fusion between Afro-Cuban music and jazz that - Normally I was brewing, you know, to make a recording and to use us as a backing, Flip Phillips, Charlie Parker, Sonny Stitt and Dexter Gordon, all those guys, so he in order to start the publicity, to make the American public or the jazz-oriented people; so he invited…
and myself to go to his, as a matter of fact, we was there a few times.
